fixed.member: og cook: normal and linear textures
fixed.summary: UASTC textures (normal maps, metallic-roughness, occlusion, masks, and colour under `cook { color_textures uastc }`) encode at the level the options set: the basis-universal binding ORed the level over its default. The default explicitly remains level 3, the previous effective level, preserving texture detail and avoiding fragmented shading on impostor trunks. RDO remains 1.0. Explicit lower levels now work as requested. Every UASTC texture recooks once.
